title: Application and Petition of the Milford Water Company pursuant to Section 2 of Chapter 165 and Section 14 of Chapter 164 of the General Laws for authority to issue and sell from time to time not more than 6,000 shares of newly authorized 6% Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, $50 par value at not less than par; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
